description.text: Why choosing this program? The university’s discipline of architecture takes the leading position home and abroad and keeps an increasing influence in the world. The graduates, including some prominent members of the Academy of Engineering of China and many noted experts, have contributed a lot to the development of architecture.Main Courses Fundamentals of Architectural Design, The Principle of Architecture Design, History of Chinese and Foreign Architecuture, Building Structure and Architectural Mechanics, Building Construction etc.Internship Graduates will have many practical teaching, including art practice, site practice, construction practice of surveying and mapping, practice of knowing architecture, design institute production practice. After this program study, students can work as a designer in design departments and become advanced engineering technicians. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Architecture by Ningbo University

duration.text: The Architecture at Ningbo University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. Health certificate(optional)Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency testIELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker.

requirements.text: 1. Over the age of 18 and hold a valid foreign passport2. Be in good health.3. Grade C or 70% in English
